notes.title: Heaven Dust 2 comes to Enter the Dragon!
notes.content:
Hello, dear players, it's been a while since the last announcement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297262/fa4590990479c612111f717d3d708b35a99e87b8.png[/img]

We have good news that Heaven Dust and Heaven Dust 2 comes to the inaugural Enter the Dragon event this time, which runs until April 29, now live! Dozens of games, demos, reveals, and sales are now at your fingertips as we shine a spotlight on some of the interesting games being developed in the Greater China region.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1032590/Heaven_Dust/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515900/Heaven_Dust_2/

Don't forget, as part of the event we'll set streaming on our store page. We hope to see you there and we welcome your support! As the Enter the Dragon sales have now started and will run throughout the event, now is the time to grab some discounts and discover some amazing games!

As always, we appreciate your continued support and motivation, and we hope you enjoy our game and the Enter the Dragon event!

notes.title: Heaven Dust 2 Release date announcement!
notes.content:
Hello, Gamers! We finally have a release date for Heaven Dust 2! 

[h2]Heaven Dust 2 will launch on PC and Nintendo Switch on January 6th, 2022!
[/h2]

Heaven Dust 2 is a love letter to classic survival horror games featuring exploration, action, puzzles, and resource management. Deep inside a research base, waking up from a cryogenic pod, you find yourself trapped in a living hell, surrounded by zombies. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515900/Heaven_Dust_2/

[quote]After a press conference, a virus outbreak happens in the mysterious First Research Center.
In the meantime, deep inside the institute, Steve wakes up from his cryogenic pod.
He finds himself trapped in a living hell, surrounded by zombies, again.
He must fight his way out even when the dreadful truth is also approaching...

"Are you ready to escape from hell again, Steve?
Or should I call you... 'Second Host'."
[/quote]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list][*]Classic survival horror genre, featuring exploration, action, puzzles, and resource management.
[*]Enhanced production value: Better graphics and effects, providing a brand new experience for players of the first game. Twice the content of the first game, prepare to embark on a 10-hour journey!
[*]Collect and combine, use various items to solve puzzles. Upgrade your inventory. Weapons no longer occupy space.
[*]Evolved combat system: Fight your way out with a dagger, submachine gun, shotgun, and grenades. Modify your weapons, upgrade them to the limit. Choose your weapon to counter different enemies, plan your strategy, seek their weak points, and destroy their defenses.
[*]Except for ordinary zombies, all kinds of mutated monsters had joined the battle too: Heavily armored Bone Fiend, regenerating Blood Fiend, approaching boomlad. And, of course, epic boss fights.
[*]Engaging plot, fun brain teasers. Players need to make an ultimate choice: Two escape routes will lead you to two different endings.
[*]Casual, Normal, and Expert difficulties for you to choose, suited to all players.[/list]

Please add our game to your wishlist to support us!

------------

We created a form to help us manage game code requests for press and content creators. If you are one of them and interested in Heaven Dust 2, you can complete the following form to apply a media/review key of it：

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdgPf_8XakgpMkXI8GnGefXq9hvIEawM1JAtooIZgFRZUis3g/viewform]Heaven Dust 2 Media/Review Key Request[/url]

The quantity of keys is limited and will be distributed selectively based on the results.

notes.title: 《Heaven Dust 2》DEMO is available now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Thank you for your of Heaven Dust and following the sequel Heaven Dust 2. Steam Next Fest is coming, and we are happy to announce that the demo for Heaven Dust 2 is ready. Go to the Steam Page and have a try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297262/094090764966ca59389594930ac1c3f51f7afbd8.png[/img]

This demo is the opening part of the official game. After a press conference, a virus outbreak happens in the mysterious First Research Center. In the meantime, deep inside the institute, Steve wakes up from his cryogenic pod. Why Steve is here? And where did the others go? Various documents in the game will give you some clues, which will help you to find out the secrets in Heaven Dust 2. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297262/7e287c376b04893c5f9b2a2532fa410c27537628.jpg[/img]

The demo will remain on the game store page after Steam Nest Fest, so you can download it anytime. Besides, there is a streaming event at 2:00 AM, June 17 (PST) and we will show the demo then. So if you're interested, just come and have a look!

If you have any problem or suggestion about the demo, feel free to tell us. Have fun~

notes.title: Heaven Dust 2 will come out later this year
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297262/03380f8669c78892bf3939dee34396db80e085e3.png[/img]

Today, One Gruel Studio and indie games publisher indienova are excited to announce that the title of our new game Heaven Dust 2 will come out later this year if everything goes well, and here's a trailer based on the WIP build we are working on. If you like it, please add it to your wishlist, it will help a lot for us:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SW7brYnohCo

It's the sequel of our last game, the survival horror thriller Heaven Dust. (Stand-alone story that does not require playing the previous game.)

[h2]Story[/h2]

After a press conference, a virus leakage incident breaks out in the mysterious First Research Center.
In the meantime, deep inside of the institute, Steve wakes up from his freeze pod.
He finds himself trapped in a living hell, surrounded by preying walking deads, again.
Following the guidance, he must fight his way out of all the ferocious monsters.
When hope shines its light, the dreadful truth is also approaching...

"Are you ready to escape from the hell again, Steve?
Or should I call you... 'Second Host'."

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Classic survival horror genre, featuring: Exploration, Action, Puzzle, Resources Management.
[*] New development scale: Better graphics and effects, providing a brand new experience. Twice of the content of the first game, prepare to embark on a 10 hours journey.
[*] Collect and combine, use various items to solve puzzles. Upgrade your inventory. Weapons no longer occupy your space.
[*] Evolved combat system: Fight your way out with your dagger, submachine gun, shotgun, and grenade. Modify your weapons, upgrade them to the limit. Choose your weapon to counter different enemies, plan your strategy, seek their weak points, destroy their defenses.
[*] Except for the ordinary zombies, all kinds of mutated monsters had joined the battle too: Heavily armored Bone Fiend, regenerating Blood Fiend, approaching boomlad. And, of course, the epic boss fights.
[*] Engaging plot, fun brain teasers. The player needs to make an ultimate choice: Two escape routes will lead you to two different endings.
[*] Casual, Normal, and Expert difficulties for you to choose, suit to all players.
[/list]
